assistant_text:
Build Self-Serve Tier currently leads by 2 percentage points, but the analysis treats this as a close call. The result is not yet robust — no single factor we tested would change the order on its own, but the margin is not settled.

Your first analysis is ready. Take a moment to explore the leading option and the factors shaping it before acting on the result.

blocks.summary: Build Self-Serve Tier currently leads by 2 percentage points, but the analysis treats this as a close call. The result is not yet robust — no single factor we tested would change the order on its own, but the margin is not settled.

robustness.display_verdict_reason: none of the factors we could test changed which option leads on its own, but this result scored low on our other robustness checks

decision_review.narrative_summary: Build Self-Serve Tier leads by a narrow margin of about 2 percentage points, but this result depends heavily on uncertain assumptions about churn and competition. The analysis is not settled enough to act on without better evidence.

story_headlines.opt_selfserve: Build Self-Serve Tier comes out ahead when product-led growth drives conversions efficiently despite competition and churn risk.
story_headlines.opt_sales: Hire Two Sales Reps could become the leader if sales hiring reliably accelerates growth or if churn and market competition data shift.
story_headlines.opt_content: Spend on Content Marketing positions the business for organic lead growth but struggles to outpace other options given current uncertainties.

robustness_explanation.summary: The ordering holds in only about 42% of variations based on current estimates, signalling substantial instability in the result.
robustness_explanation.primary_risk: The link from Self-Serve Product Tier to Product-Led Growth Conversion is the biggest threat to the result's stability.
stability_factors: Assumed impact of Self-Serve Product Tier on conversion rates anchors the current lead.
Allocation of growth budget impacts which strategic bet looks most effective.
fragility_factors: The link from Self-Serve Product Tier to Product-Led Growth Conversion could easily flip the result.
The link from Competitive Intensity to New Sales Pipeline Generated may undermine the expected advantage.

decision_review.readiness_rationale: Major gaps in evidence for Churn Trend and Competitive Intensity prevent a firm conclusion. Uncertainties about how Self-Serve and sales hires affect growth keep this decision open.

fac_churn_trend.specific_action: Collect recent monthly churn data segmented by customer cohort, and compare with historical patterns to clarify the churn trend.
fac_churn_trend.rationale: This will clarify if rising churn could undermine any growth strategy and determine whether retention efforts are urgent.
fac_churn_trend.decision_hygiene: Have team members independently estimate churn before reviewing the new data.

fac_market_competition.specific_action: Conduct targeted competitor interviews and review industry reports to map new entrants and their offers.
fac_market_competition.rationale: Understanding shifts in competitive intensity may reveal threats to growth assumptions in each scenario.
fac_market_competition.decision_hygiene: Document current beliefs about key competitors before gathering new information.

fac_budget.specific_action: Run a detailed review of available funds versus planned hires and marketing commitments for the next 12 months.
fac_budget.rationale: This will make explicit how each option fits within the £150,000 cap without overstretching cash.
fac_budget.decision_hygiene: List all projected outflows before calculating if each plan is financially feasible.

fac_selfserve->out_product_led_growth.trigger_description: If the Self-Serve Product Tier does not significantly improve Product-Led Growth Conversion, or adoption lags...
fac_selfserve->out_product_led_growth.consequence: then Hire Two Sales Reps overtakes Build Self-Serve Tier as the leading option.

fac_content_spend->out_organic_leads.trigger_description: If Content Marketing Investment produces a sharp rise in Organic Lead Volume...
fac_content_spend->out_organic_leads.consequence: then Hire Two Sales Reps overtakes Build Self-Serve Tier in this scenario.

key_assumptions: The link from Self-Serve Product Tier to Product-Led Growth Conversion assumes new users will convert at expected rates.
Competitive Intensity is assumed to remain stable and not worsen unexpectedly.
Current ARR is assumed to provide a reliable base for future projections.

decision_quality_prompts.question: What external data would most shift your confidence in the Self-Serve Product Tier as a growth channel?
decision_quality_prompts.principle: Outside view and reference class forecasting
decision_quality_prompts.applies_because: The outcome is highly uncertain due to provisional estimates on churn and competition; looking outward could ground expectations.

decision_quality_prompts.question: What would make you switch to Hire Two Sales Reps instead of building a Self-Serve Product Tier?
decision_quality_prompts.applies_because: Build Self-Serve Tier currently leads by a slim margin, so considering what could justify switching is especially valuable.
